item.title: US is Struggling to Build Affordable Housing
item.description: [Bloomberg] America’s housing affordability crisis may be about more than high mortgage rates and restrictive zoning. He points to research showing construction productivity has barely improved in decades, even as productivity across much of the rest of the economy has surged. (Source: Bloomberg)
